description: Find products businesses sell, by words or a barcode (GTIN, EAN, UPC, ISBN), brand and part number, place, price, currency and stock. Each comes with offers: one business's price as last checked, and its own door to order through. Prices are never converted. A barcode is one product per multipack: single units and a pack of them are apart, and a pack's offer gives its price per unit too. A business's variants of one product, when its catalogue groups them, are one product with one place (variants). Read the price at the business's door and order there; this server takes no orders or payments. Pages of up to 20: pass next_cursor as cursor.

availability.description: Only offers with one of these: in_stock and on_sale (available, its stock not counted) when left out.

brand.description: The maker's brand, with mpn: that exact part.

condition.description: Only offers in one of these conditions: any when left out.

country.description: Only businesses in this country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, like PT.

currency.description: Only offers in this currency (ISO 4217, like EUR). Prices are never converted.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page, with the same arguments.

domain.description: Only this business's products: its domain.

gtin.description: A barcode: GTIN-8, -12, -13 or -14, EAN, UPC or ISBN, in any length or with (01) in front. Checked, and it replaces query.

has_inbox.description: Every offer here comes from a business's own inbox: false leaves nothing.

mpn.description: The maker's part number, with brand.

multipack.description: Only products of this many identical units sold together: 1 for single units, 12 for packs of 12. Any when left out.

near.description: Only offers of businesses within radius_km of this point, each with its distance.

radius_km.description: How far from the point, in kilometres: 10 when left out.

order.description: published (the default): each offer in its business's place in the directory's published order. price: lowest price as sold first (a pack's whole price), with currency. nearest: nearest first, with near.

price_max.description: At most this price as sold (a pack's whole price), in the currency's minor unit. Needs currency.

price_min.description: At least this price as sold (a pack's whole price, not its price per unit), in the currency's minor unit (cents for EUR, yen for JPY). Needs currency.

query.description: A few words from the product's name, brand or description, like "moka pot". Every word must match, ignoring capitals and accents.

ships_to.description: Only businesses that say they deliver to this country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2.

name: search_products

outputSchema.description: Every field is described in this tool's outputSchema at https://network.surfingdog.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.

title: Find products
